title: Special yard regulations
previewText:

blocks.html: The yard regulations of the underlying districts shall apply, except as specified in this Section.
blocks.plainText: The yard regulations of the underlying districts shall apply, except as specified in this Section.

blocks.html:
(a)        Manufacturing or commercial buildings

The rear yard provisions of the designated M1 District shall not apply to manufacturing or commercial buildings on through lots.
blocks.plainText: (a) Manufacturing or commercial buildings The rear yard provisions of the designated M1 District shall not apply to manufacturing or commercial buildings on through lots.

blocks.html:
(b)        Zoning lots adjacent to the Sunnyside Yard

On a zoning lot sharing a lot line with the Sunnyside Yard, no yards are required for any building within a distance of 100 feet from the shared lot line.
blocks.plainText: (b) Zoning lots adjacent to the Sunnyside Yard On a zoning lot sharing a lot line with the Sunnyside Yard, no yards are required for any building within a distance of 100 feet from the shared lot line.

blocks.html:
(c)        For zoning lots occupying an entire block

No rear yard or rear yard equivalent shall be required for a zoning lot occupying an entire block.
blocks.plainText: (c) For zoning lots occupying an entire block No rear yard or rear yard equivalent shall be required for a zoning lot occupying an entire block.
